en_title: GTA 6 Will Run at 30fps On All Consoles, Features Ray Tracing Improvements on PS5 Pro
cn_title: 《GTA6》将在所有主机上以30fps运行，PS5 Pro版的光线追踪有所改进
opus_summary: Rockstar公布《GTA6》主机版性能信息：游戏在各主机上均以30帧为目标，PS5 Pro版将改进光线追踪。PS5及PS5 Pro支持DualSense触觉反馈和Tempest 3D音频。游戏还可通过XBOX云游戏游玩，画面采用XBOX Series S设置。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has finally announced performance for GTA 6 . It’ll run at 30fps on all consoles, but PS5 Pro enhancements improve ray tracing.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar终于公布了《GTA6》的性能表现。游戏将在所有主机上以30fps运行，但PS5 Pro增强功能改进了光线追踪效果。

paragraphs.en: “Grand Theft Auto VI has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life — while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants,” Rockstar said in a post.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar在一篇帖子中表示：「《侠盗猎车手VI》完全从零开始开发，旨在为当前世代主机提供尽可能出色的体验。游戏以每秒30帧为目标，同时将两个平台的性能发挥到极限，让Leonida广阔而丰富的世界栩栩如生，并保持所有环境和居民的密度与视觉保真度。」

paragraphs.en: That means no matter what console you play on — PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X, or Xbox Series S — the game will run at, or below, 30fps. “Targeting 30fps” is different to locked 30fps, so there’s likely some fluctuation in busy scenes.
paragraphs.cn: 这意味着无论你在哪台主机上游玩——PS5、PS5 Pro、XBOX Series X还是XBOX Series S——游戏都将以30fps或更低帧率运行。「以30fps为目标」与锁定30fps不同，因此在复杂场景中帧率可能会有所波动。

paragraphs.en: Ray tracing allows for finer detail in shadows, as well as shadows that naturally blur and widen the farther away they get from the object casting them, matching the physical size of the light source. Improvements here are only available on PS5 Pro.
paragraphs.cn: 光线追踪能够让阴影呈现更精细的细节，也能让阴影随着距离投射阴影的物体越来越远而自然变得模糊和宽阔，与光源的物理尺寸相匹配。这方面的改进仅在PS5 Pro上提供。

paragraphs.en: There are also some PlayStation exclusive details in the controls, which support high-fidelity haptic feedback on the DualSense controller — Rockstar says it “fully integrated” this into the game. The same goes for Sony’s Tempest 3D audio for spatial sound improvements.
paragraphs.cn: 操作方面也有一些PlayStation独占细节，游戏支持DualSense手柄的高保真触觉反馈——Rockstar表示已将其「完全整合」进游戏。索尼的Tempest 3D音频也是如此，它带来了空间音效方面的改进。

paragraphs.en: Those last two are true for both base PS5 and PS5 Pro. All this and improved load times make “Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles,” according to Rockstar.
paragraphs.cn: 最后这两项功能在基础版PS5和PS5 Pro上都适用。Rockstar表示，所有这些功能以及缩短的加载时间使「《侠盗猎车手VI》在PS5主机上的游玩体验最佳」。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 will also be available to play via Xbox’s Cloud Gaming on all Xbox consoles, including Xbox One, surprisingly. The game will utilize Xbox Series S graphics settings, however.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》也将可以通过XBOX的Cloud Gaming在所有XBOX主机上游玩，令人意外的是，这其中还包括XBOX One。不过，游戏将使用XBOX Series S的画面设置。

paragraphs.en: There are no details about how the game runs on Xbox Series S, but it’s widely expected to be the inferior version of the game due to the lower hardware specs of the console.
paragraphs.cn: 目前尚无关于游戏在XBOX Series S上运行表现的详细信息，但由于该主机的硬件规格较低，人们普遍预计这个版本的表现会较差。

paragraphs.en: “As with all cloud streaming, connection speeds and other technical factors may influence game performance in ways that would not impact local gameplay,” Rockstar said.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar表示：「与所有云串流一样，连接速度和其他技术因素可能会以不会影响本地游玩的方式影响游戏表现。」

paragraphs.en: You’ll also be able to play GTA 6 on Remote Play on both PlayStation and Xbox consoles when it launches on November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》于11月19日推出时，你也将能够通过PlayStation和XBOX主机上的Remote Play游玩。
